chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) dictated this supplication to me, and it is comprehensive for the world and the Hereafter. You should say after praising Allah and lauding Him:

O Allah, You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Forbearing, the Benevolent; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Mighty, the Wise. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the One, the Subduer; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the King, the Compeller. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Merciful, the Forgiver.

And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Severe in Punishment; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Great, the Exalted. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Hearing, the Seeing; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Invincible, the All-Powerful. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Forgiving, the Appreciative; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.

And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Forgiving, the Loving; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Affectionate, the Bestower. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Forbearing, the Recompenser; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Generous, the Noble. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the One, the Unique.

And You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Unseen, the Witness; and You are Allah, there is no god except You, the Manifest, the Hidden. And You are Allah, there is no god except You, Knower of everything. Your Light is Perfect, so You Guide, and You Extended Your Hand, so You Gave.
Our Lord, Your Face is the most Benevolent of faces, and Your Direction is the best of directions, and Your Gift is the most superior of gifts and the most delightful.

You are obeyed, Our Lord, so You are thanked; and You are disobeyed, Our Lord, so You forgive whomever You will. You Answer the desperate ones, and Remove the evil, and Accept the repentance, and Pardon the sins.
Your Favors cannot be repaid, nor can Your Bounties be counted, nor can the speech of a speaker reach Your Praise.

O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and Hasten their relief, and their comfort, and their rest, and their joy. And cause me to taste the pleasure of their relief, and Destroy their enemies from the Jinn and the humans.
And Give us goodness in the world and goodness in the Hereafter, and Save us from the Punishment of the Fire, and Make us from those upon whom there is no fear, nor shall they grieve.
And Make me from those who were patient and upon their Lord relied, and Affirm me with the Firm Word in the life of the world and in the Hereafter.

And Bless me in the life, and the death, and the Standing, and the Resurrection, and the Reckoning, and the Scale, and the Horrors of the Day of Judgment. And Secure me upon the Bridge, and Allow me to pass upon it.
And Grant me beneficial knowledge and sincere conviction, and piety, and righteousness, and devoutness, and fear of You, and awe that brings me closer to You and does not distance me from You.
And Love me and do not Hate me, and Befriend me and do not Abandon me.

And Give me from all the goodness of the world and the Hereafter, what I know of it and what I do not know of it, and Rescue me from all evil, in its entirety, what I know of it and what I do not know of it.
ai.seo_question: What is the comprehensive supplication for all needs of the world and the Hereafter in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this supplication is classified as *Jami' al-Dunya wa al-Akhira* (comprehensive for both worlds), reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual devotion with worldly well-being. It structurally moves from affirming God’s attributes (*Asma al-Husna*) to invoking blessings upon the Ahl al-Bayt, and finally requesting steadfastness (*Thabat*) and protection, mirroring the theological framework of *Tawhid* and *Imamah*.

en.sarwar: 18. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from Khalaf ibn Hammad from ‘Amr ibn abu al-Miqdam who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) dictated this supplication to me and it is of universal benefit for this and the hereafter. Say after thanking and praising Allah: “

O Lord, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Forbearing, the Magnanimous, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Majestic, the Wise, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the One and only, the Conqueror, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the King, the Compeller, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Merciful, the Forgiver, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, Whose retribution is most intense, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Great, the Most High, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, The Hearer, the Seeing, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Defender, the Most Powerful, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Lenient, the Appreciator, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Praiseworthy, the Glorious, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Forgiving, the Loving, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Compassionate, the Obliging, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Forbearing, the recompensing. You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Generous, the Exalted, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the One, the Only, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Unseen, the Ever Present, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, the Apparent and Hidden, You are Allah, no one deserves to be worshipped except You, Who has the knowledge of all things. Your light is complete. You guide, You extend Your hand and give,
O our Lord, Your face is the Most Honorable face, Your direction is the best direction. Your gift is the best gift and the most pleasant.
When You, our Lord, are obeyed You appreciate, when You are disobeyed You forgive whoever You will. You answer the helpless and remove evil, accept repentance, and ignore sins.
Your gifts cannot be matched and Y our bounties cannot be counted. The words of praising people cannot reach (the limits of) Your praise.

“O Lord, grant al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family, grant them happiness quicker, grant them joy, comfort and delight. Make me feel the test of their happiness; destroy their enemies, among the Jinn and human beings.

Confer upon us goodness in this world and in the hereafter and protect us against the fire, make us of those who will suffer no fear and sadness and make me of those who exercise patience and place their trust in their Lord, keep me steadfast with the solid word in this life and in the hereafter, bestow upon me blessings in life and in death, on the Day of Judgment, resurrection, reckoning, the balance and in the horrors of the Day of Judgment, keep me safe on the bridge, help me pass over it, grant me beneficial knowledge, true certainty, piety, restraint from worldly things, fear of You and concern that make me reach Your success, will not take me away from You, make me loveable and not hated, receiving support, not betrayed, and grant me all the good of this and the hereafter that I know or that which I do not know, protect me against all evil in its entirety, that which I know and that which I do not know.’”
